packs.acme: scoreboard/fixture/library.json (Acme DS sample; regression-gate library id "fixture")
packs.acme-small: Acme UI test graph in tests/meaning.score.ts (regression-gate library id "acme-small"); the only Acme pack with density list variants

scoring.exact: top-1 lead equals expect.lead, or is one of alternates
scoring.empty-or-weak: no lead, or a lead marked weak match (no fit); any sure lead fails
scoring.empty: no lead at all; a weak lead also fails
scoring.top3: expect.lead or an alternate appears in the first 3 candidates
